content.intro: This lesson covers Cross-Compilation and Target Triples. It sits in Module 23, Compiler, Build System, and Performance, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Cross-Compilation and Target Triples matters when you work with toolchain and compiler feedback. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.
